
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20176770" title="发布于 2026-05-26 22:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript定制left/right join查询语法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="pm_GtQkZ">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展自定义语法。</p>
<p data-pid="YuE7e5pq">在之前的文章<a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/20065217" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">《AScript如何实现LINQ语法》</a>中实现了C#标准LINQ查询语法，但并不支持<code>left join/right join</code>语句，不过.NET10在<code>Queryable/Enumerable</code>中新增了<code>LeftJoin/RightJoin</code>扩展方法（LINQ查询语法中仍然不支持<code>left join/right join</code>写法）。</p>
<p data-pid="11Yg3Izx">本篇将在LINQ语法的基础上增加<code>left join</code>和<code>right join</code>语法，以提高脚本灵活性。</p>
<h2>一、left join</h2>
<p data-pid="Cl81qgDs">标准LINQ查询的左连接写法如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> join a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId into aa
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> aa.DefaultIfEmpty()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { p.Id, p.Name, p.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };</pre>
</div>
<p>简化后的<code>left join</code>语法如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> left join a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { p.Id, p.Name, p.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="zMjfw-gQ">如何实现呢？</p>
<h3>1、在QueryNode中添加AddLeftJoin方法</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AddLeftJoin(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> varName, ITreeNode source, ITreeNode key1, ITreeNode key2)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> name1 = $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">___{varName}___</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    AddJoin(varName, source, key1, key2, name1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     AddFrom(varName, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CallFuncNode { Name = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DefaultIfEmpty</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, Args = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ITreeNode[] { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VariableNode(name1) } });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="8D8K5aew">可以看到，<code>AddLeftJoin</code>方法中我们手动增加了<code>join ... into xxx</code>和<code>from ... xxx.DefaultIfEmpty()</code>语句。</p>
<h3>2、在FromTokenHandler中添加left join解析</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     e.IsHandled = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> queryNode = e.Ignore ? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> QueryNode();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> createFullOptions = (e.Options.CreateFullTreeNode ?? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>) ? e.Options : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BuildOptions(e.Options) { CreateFullTreeNode = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析from语句</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    BuildFrom(analyzer, e, createFullOptions, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 解析后续linq语句</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> token =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.TokenReader.Read();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">join</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            BuildJoin(analyzer, e, createFullOptions, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">left</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            BuildLeftJoin(analyzer, e, createFullOptions, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (token.Value.IsSymbol(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">right</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            BuildRightJoin(analyzer, e, createFullOptions, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将LINQ语句添加到语法树中</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">e.Ignore)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        e.TreeBuilder.AddData(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.Control, queryNode);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildLeftJoin(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e, BuildOptions createFullOptions, QueryNode queryNode)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">join</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">equals</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _Join2EndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span>     queryNode?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.AddLeftJoin(varToken.Value.Value, source, key1, key2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>这样我们就实现了<code>left join</code>语法，以后在脚本中写左连接语句就方便多了。</p>
<blockquote>
<p data-pid="Cl81qgDs">sqlite查询完整示例</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestSqliteContext())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = from p in context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    left join a in context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    select new { p.Id, p.Name, p.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(list, Formatting.Indented));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>生成的sqlite查询语句为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> "p"."Id", "p"."Name", "p"."Age", "a"."Address" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "MyAddress"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> "Persons" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "p"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">LEFT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> "AddressInfos" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "a" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> "p"."Id" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> "a"."UserId"</pre>
</div>
<h2>二、right join</h2>
<p data-pid="X9J7ZKfS">标准LINQ查询要实现右连接，只能用左连接语句并交换2个表的位置来实现右连接功能。</p>
<p data-pid="nzyZwx2U">比如上面的示例中把左连接AddressInfos表改为右连接，则交换2个表位置：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.AddressInfos
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> left join p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Persons on a.UserId equals p.Id
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { p.Id, p.Name, p?.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };</pre>
</div>
<p>虽然能实现右连接效果，但是写法不太符合我们的逻辑，使用<code>right join</code>语法如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> p <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> right join a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { p.Id, p.Name, p?.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="-8npH-FT">如何实现<code>right join</code>语法呢？</p>
<h3>1、在QueryNode中添加AddRightJoin方法</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> AddRightJoin(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> varName, ITreeNode source, ITreeNode key1, ITreeNode key2)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> right =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _Source;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> rightName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _CurrentVarName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span>     _Source =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> source;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span>     _CurrentVarName =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> varName;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    AddLeftJoin(rightName, right, key2, key1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="N7-0FJ0K">没错，就是交换2个表的位置使用左连接来实现。</p>
<h3>2、在FromTokenHandler中添加right join解析</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildRightJoin(DefaultSyntaxAnalyzer analyzer, TokenAnalyzingArgs e, BuildOptions createFullOptions, QueryNode queryNode)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">join</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> varToken =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, ETokenType.Word);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> source =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _OnTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">on</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _EqualsTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>     analyzer.ValidateNextToken(e.TokenReader, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">equals</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> key2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> analyzer.BuildOneStatement(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, createFullOptions, e.TokenReader, e.Control, e.Ignore, _Join2EndTokens);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     queryNode?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.AddRightJoin(varToken.Value.Value, source, key1, key2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<blockquote>
<p>sqlite查询完整示例</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestSqliteContext())
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = from p in context.Persons
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    right join a in context.AddressInfos on p.Id equals a.UserId
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    select new { p.Id, p.Name, p?.Age, MyAddress = a.Address };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">context</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, context);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Console.WriteLine(JsonConvert.SerializeObject(list, Formatting.Indented));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>生成的sqlit查询语句为（左连接交换2个表位置）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> "p"."Id", "p"."Name", "p"."Age", "a"."Address" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "MyAddress"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> "AddressInfos" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> "a"
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">LEFT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> "Persons" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span> "p" <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> "a"."UserId" <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> "p"."Id"</pre>
</div>
<h2>三、结束语</h2>
<p data-pid="MmdtddOY">虽然是2个小小的语法，却大大提高了我们的脚本编写效率。</p>
<p data-pid="sxw0KGfb">AScript开源地址：<a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></p>

</div>
